_why: A PARTIAL run manifest (some counties complete this run, the rest carried over as not-run) — same shape as every manifest this project has ever actually produced, since a full 12-county sweep succeeding in one run with nothing left `not-run` is the case that has never once happened. Paired with an absurd --max-age-days, this proves check-freshness.mjs now treats `partial` as usable evidence of freshness at all, matching publish/status.ts (`ok = complete`, `degraded = partial`, both count as a real last_success). Before this fixture, only `status: 'complete'` counted, so this exact, representative manifest shape read as UNKNOWN forever regardless of age.
